meta.title: Vendors cannot see other competing vendors invited to the Request for Best Offer
gaps: Assert that Vendor A's participant or details widget specifically omits Vendor B's actual identity, because the case does not name Vendor B and no catalog step enumerates competitor visibility on the vendor portal.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Assert that Vendor A's participant or details widget specifically omits Vendor B's actual identity, because the case does not name Vendor B and no catalog step enumerates competitor visibility on the vendor portal.

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow for the RFQ.
Give the event the required title so it can be published and opened by the vendor portal.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add a product so the RFQ bidding panel can be rendered.
Invite two vendors, matching the required Vendor A and Vendor B audience without inventing company names.
Publish the RFQ so it is live for the invited vendor.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Switch to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the live RFQ pricing stage as the vendor and land on the vendor's own bidding panel.
Assert that the vendor sees its own RFQ submission control.
Assert that the vendor sees its own pricing panel rather than only an unrelated event screen.
